question: How many points did Verstappen score at the 2021 Belgian Grand Prix?
sql: SELECT x.season, x.round, x.name, d.full_name, r.team, r.grid, r.position, r.position_text, r.status, r.points FROM results r JOIN races x ON x.id = r.race_id JOIN drivers d ON d.id = r.driver_id WHERE x.season = 2021 AND x.circuit_ref = 'spa' AND d.full_name = 'Max Verstappen' ORDER BY r.position
why_hard: The race was stopped behind the safety car, so only half points were paid: 12.5, not 25.

question: What happened to Verstappen at the 2003 Monaco Grand Prix?
sql: SELECT x.season, x.round, x.name, d.full_name, r.team, r.grid, r.position, r.position_text, r.status, r.points FROM results r JOIN races x ON x.id = r.race_id JOIN drivers d ON d.id = r.driver_id WHERE x.season = 2003 AND x.circuit_ref = 'monaco' AND d.full_name LIKE '%Verstappen' ORDER BY r.position
why_hard: Max Verstappen did not race until 2015; in 2003 Verstappen means Jos, who retired with a fuel system problem.

question: Who was on the podium at the 2024 Belgian Grand Prix?
sql: SELECT x.season, x.round, x.name, d.full_name, r.team, r.grid, r.position, r.position_text, r.status, r.points FROM results r JOIN races x ON x.id = r.race_id JOIN drivers d ON d.id = r.driver_id WHERE x.season = 2024 AND x.circuit_ref = 'spa' AND (r.position <= 4 OR d.full_name = 'George Russell') ORDER BY r.position
why_hard: Russell crossed the line first but was disqualified, so the official podium is Hamilton, Piastri and Leclerc.

question: How many drivers started the 2023 Italian Grand Prix?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.position_text <> 'W') AS started, COUNT(*) AS listed, STRING_AGG(d.full_name || ' ' || r.position_text || ' ' || r.status, ', ') FILTER (WHERE r.position_text = 'W') AS did_not_start FROM results r JOIN races x ON x.id = r.race_id JOIN drivers d ON d.id = r.driver_id WHERE x.season = 2023 AND x.circuit_ref = 'monza'
why_hard: The results list 20 drivers, but Tsunoda has position_text 'W' (did not start), so 19 started.

question: Why was Hamilton disqualified from the 2024 Belgian Grand Prix?
sql: SELECT x.season, x.round, x.name, d.full_name, r.team, r.grid, r.position, r.position_text, r.status, r.points FROM results r JOIN races x ON x.id = r.race_id JOIN drivers d ON d.id = r.driver_id WHERE x.season = 2024 AND x.circuit_ref = 'spa' AND (r.position = 1 OR r.status = 'Disqualified') ORDER BY r.position
why_hard: False premise: Russell was the disqualified driver and Hamilton inherited the win.

question: Why did Verstappen retire from the 2023 Italian Grand Prix?
sql: SELECT x.season, x.round, x.name, d.full_name, r.team, r.grid, r.position, r.position_text, r.status, r.points FROM results r JOIN races x ON x.id = r.race_id JOIN drivers d ON d.id = r.driver_id WHERE x.season = 2023 AND x.circuit_ref = 'monza' AND d.full_name = 'Max Verstappen' ORDER BY r.position
why_hard: False premise: Verstappen won that race, he did not retire.

question: Who won at Silverstone in 2020?
sql: SELECT x.season, x.round, x.name, d.full_name, r.team, r.grid, r.position, r.position_text, r.status, r.points FROM results r JOIN races x ON x.id = r.race_id JOIN drivers d ON d.id = r.driver_id WHERE x.season = 2020 AND x.circuit_ref = 'silverstone' AND r.position = 1 ORDER BY r.position
why_hard: Silverstone hosted two races in 2020 (British GP and 70th Anniversary GP) with different winners.

question: Where did Schumacher finish at the 2001 San Marino Grand Prix?
sql: SELECT x.name, d.full_name, r.team, r.grid, r.position, r.position_text, r.status FROM results r JOIN races x ON x.id = r.race_id JOIN drivers d ON d.id = r.driver_id WHERE x.season = 2001 AND x.circuit_ref = 'imola' AND d.full_name LIKE '%Schumacher' ORDER BY r.position
why_hard: Michael and Ralf Schumacher both raced: Ralf won, Michael retired with a suspension failure.

question: Who won the Grand Prix in Spain in 2026?
sql: SELECT x.season, x.round, x.name, d.full_name, r.team, r.grid, r.position, r.position_text, r.status, r.points FROM results r JOIN races x ON x.id = r.race_id JOIN drivers d ON d.id = r.driver_id WHERE x.season = 2026 AND x.circuit_ref IN ('catalunya', 'madring') AND r.position = 1 ORDER BY r.position
why_hard: 2026 has both a Barcelona Grand Prix (Catalunya, round 7) and a Spanish Grand Prix (Madring, round 14), with different winners.

question: What tire did the winner of the 2023 Italian Grand Prix start on?
sql: SELECT l.stint_number, l.tire_type, MIN(l.lap_number) AS first_lap, MAX(l.lap_number) AS last_lap FROM laps l JOIN races x ON x.id = l.race_id JOIN drivers d ON d.id = l.driver_id WHERE x.season = 2023 AND x.circuit_ref = 'monza' AND d.full_name = 'Max Verstappen' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
why_hard: Needs the winner from the results, then that driver's stint data.

question: How many points did the winner of the 2022 Monaco Grand Prix score that season, sprints included?
sql: SELECT d.full_name, (SELECT SUM(r2.points) FROM results r2 JOIN races x2 ON x2.id = r2.race_id WHERE x2.season = 2022 AND r2.driver_id = d.id) AS race_points, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.points), 0) FROM sprint_results s JOIN races y ON y.id = s.race_id WHERE y.season = 2022 AND s.driver_id = d.id) AS sprint_points FROM drivers d WHERE d.full_name IN ('Sergio Pérez')
why_hard: Needs the winner (Perez) and then his season total: 291 race points plus 14 sprint points.

question: Did the pole sitter win the 2023 Hungarian Grand Prix? If not, who did?
sql: SELECT x.season, x.round, x.name, d.full_name, r.team, r.grid, r.position, r.position_text, r.status, r.points FROM results r JOIN races x ON x.id = r.race_id JOIN drivers d ON d.id = r.driver_id WHERE x.season = 2023 AND x.circuit_ref = 'hungaroring' AND (r.grid = 1 OR r.position = 1) ORDER BY r.position
why_hard: Needs the front-row starter (Hamilton), then the winner (Verstappen) to compare.

question: How many more races did Verstappen win in 2023 than in 2024?
sql: SELECT x.season, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.position_text = '1') AS wins FROM results r JOIN races x ON x.id = r.race_id JOIN drivers d ON d.id = r.driver_id WHERE d.full_name = 'Max Verstappen' AND x.season IN (2023, 2024) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
why_hard: Two season lookups (19 wins and 9 wins) and a subtraction.

question: What tire was the winner of the 2024 São Paulo Grand Prix on at the finish?
sql: SELECT l.stint_number, l.tire_type, MIN(l.lap_number) AS first_lap, MAX(l.lap_number) AS last_lap FROM laps l JOIN races x ON x.id = l.race_id JOIN drivers d ON d.id = l.driver_id WHERE x.season = 2024 AND x.circuit_ref = 'interlagos' AND d.full_name = 'Max Verstappen' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
why_hard: Needs the winner (Verstappen, from 17th on the grid), then his last stint.

question: Which team scored the most points at the 2023 Belgian Grand Prix, and how many?
sql: SELECT r.team, SUM(r.points) AS team_points FROM results r JOIN races x ON x.id = r.race_id JOIN drivers d ON d.id = r.driver_id WHERE x.season = 2023 AND x.circuit_ref = 'spa' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3
why_hard: Team points mean adding both cars across the whole results table.

question: How many points did McLaren score at the 2023 British Grand Prix?
sql: SELECT r.team, SUM(r.points) AS team_points, STRING_AGG(d.full_name || ' ' || r.points, ', ') FROM results r JOIN races x ON x.id = r.race_id JOIN drivers d ON d.id = r.driver_id WHERE x.season = 2023 AND x.circuit_ref = 'silverstone' AND r.team = 'McLaren' GROUP BY 1
why_hard: Needs both McLaren cars added together (18 + 12).

question: Who gained the most places from the grid to the finish at the 2023 Austrian Grand Prix?
sql: SELECT d.full_name, r.grid, r.position, r.grid - r.position AS places_gained FROM results r JOIN races x ON x.id = r.race_id JOIN drivers d ON d.id = r.driver_id WHERE x.season = 2023 AND x.circuit_ref = 'red_bull_ring' AND r.position_text ~ '^[0-9]+$' ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 3
why_hard: Needs grid minus finish for every driver in the race; no pit-lane starters to confuse it.

question: Who scored more points in 2024, Norris or Piastri, including sprints, and how many did each get?
sql: SELECT d.full_name, (SELECT SUM(r2.points) FROM results r2 JOIN races x2 ON x2.id = r2.race_id WHERE x2.season = 2024 AND r2.driver_id = d.id) AS race_points, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.points), 0) FROM sprint_results s JOIN races y ON y.id = s.race_id WHERE y.season = 2024 AND s.driver_id = d.id) AS sprint_points FROM drivers d WHERE d.full_name IN ('Lando Norris', 'Oscar Piastri')
why_hard: Race points and sprint points must be added: Norris 344 + 30, Piastri 265 + 27.

question: By how many points did Verstappen beat Hamilton for the 2021 drivers' title, counting sprint points?
sql: SELECT d.full_name, (SELECT SUM(r2.points) FROM results r2 JOIN races x2 ON x2.id = r2.race_id WHERE x2.season = 2021 AND r2.driver_id = d.id) AS race_points, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.points), 0) FROM sprint_results s JOIN races y ON y.id = s.race_id WHERE y.season = 2021 AND s.driver_id = d.id) AS sprint_points FROM drivers d WHERE d.full_name IN ('Max Verstappen', 'Lewis Hamilton')
why_hard: Sprint points decide the margin: 388.5 + 7 = 395.5 against 385.5 + 2 = 387.5, so 8 (race points alone give 3).

question: How many points did Racing Bulls score in the 2024 season, sprints included?
sql: SELECT t.team, (SELECT SUM(r2.points) FROM results r2 JOIN races x2 ON x2.id = r2.race_id WHERE x2.season = 2024 AND r2.team = t.team) AS race_points, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.points), 0) FROM sprint_results s JOIN races y ON y.id = s.race_id WHERE y.season = 2024 AND s.team = t.team) AS sprint_points FROM (SELECT DISTINCT r3.team FROM results r3 JOIN races x3 ON x3.id = r3.race_id WHERE x3.season = 2024 AND r3.team IN ('RB F1 Team')) t
why_hard: The database calls the team 'RB F1 Team'; people say Racing Bulls or Visa Cash App RB.

question: What happened to Checo at the 2023 Mexico City Grand Prix?

why_hard: Checo is Sergio Perez, who is stored under his full name.

question: How many podiums did Kimi have in 2025?

why_hard: In 2025 Kimi is Andrea Kimi Antonelli (Raikkonen had retired), stored by his full name.

question: Who was leading the 2024 São Paulo Grand Prix at the end of lap 35?
sql: SELECT l.lap_number, d.full_name, l.position FROM laps l JOIN races x ON x.id = l.race_id JOIN drivers d ON d.id = l.driver_id WHERE x.season = 2024 AND x.circuit_ref = 'interlagos' AND l.lap_number BETWEEN 30 AND 40 AND l.position = 1 ORDER BY l.lap_number
why_hard: Running order per lap is in laps.position, but no tool returns it; Ocon, not the winner, led laps 29 to 42.

question: On which lap did Verstappen set his fastest lap at Monza in 2023?
sql: SELECT l.lap_number, l.lap_time_seconds, l.is_pit_out_lap, l.is_deleted FROM laps l JOIN races x ON x.id = l.race_id JOIN drivers d ON d.id = l.driver_id WHERE x.season = 2023 AND x.circuit_ref = 'monza' AND d.full_name = 'Max Verstappen' AND l.lap_time_seconds IS NOT NULL ORDER BY l.lap_time_seconds LIMIT 3
why_hard: The tools give the fastest time but not the lap it was set on.

question: How many laps did Norris have deleted at the 2024 Austrian Grand Prix?

why_hard: laps.is_deleted holds deleted laps per driver, but the tools only exclude them from averages.

question: How many laps did Verstappen do quicker than 1:26 at the 2023 Italian Grand Prix?

why_hard: Counting laps under a threshold needs the full lap table, which no tool returns.

question: How many seconds was Verstappen stationary in the pits at Monza 2023?
sql: SELECT d.full_name, p.lap_number, p.lane_seconds, p.stationary_seconds FROM pit_stops p JOIN races x ON x.id = p.race_id JOIN drivers d ON d.id = p.driver_id WHERE x.season = 2023 AND x.circuit_ref = 'monza' AND d.full_name = 'Max Verstappen'

question: After which round of the 2024 season was Norris furthest behind Verstappen in the championship, and by how many points?
sql: SELECT round, name, gap FROM (WITH pts AS (SELECT race_id, driver_id, points FROM results UNION ALL SELECT race_id, driver_id, points FROM sprint_results), per AS (SELECT x.round, x.name, d.full_name, SUM(p.points) AS pts FROM pts p JOIN races x ON x.id = p.race_id JOIN drivers d ON d.id = p.driver_id WHERE x.season = 2024 AND d.full_name IN ('Max Verstappen', 'Lando Norris') GROUP BY 1, 2, 3), cum AS (SELECT round, name, full_name, SUM(pts) OVER (PARTITION BY full_name ORDER BY round) AS total FROM per) SELECT v.round, v.name, v.total - n.total AS gap FROM cum v JOIN cum n ON n.round = v.round AND n.full_name = 'Lando Norris' WHERE v.full_name = 'Max Verstappen') AS ranked ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 3
why_hard: Needs the running championship totals after every round, sprints included, not a single race or season total: the gap peaked at 84 points after round 12 (British GP), then Norris closed to 63 by the finale.
